GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active listening, Oral expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active listening, Oral expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active listening, Oral expression.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active listening, Oral expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active listening, Oral expression.

2. When practising Listening for information, Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Active Listening, Oral Expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening, Oral Expressions.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening, Oral Expressions.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening, Oral Expressions.

4. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Wasser
   B. Schule
   C. Haus
   D. Buch

5. When practising Listening for information, Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information, Interactive speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information, Interactive speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information, Interactive speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information, Interactive speaking.

6. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.

7. When practising Active Listening, Oral expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening, Oral expressions.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening, Oral expressions.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening, Oral expressions.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening, Oral expressions.

8. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Good night
   C. Thank you
   D. Please

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
9. In three clear sentences, explain Active Listening, Oral Expressions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for information, Interactive speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Active Listening, Oral Expressions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for information, Interactive speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
